legalMoves.description: Smyth's reward: take Metal Platforms free (cost and prerequisite waived) — All robot platforms gain +1 DEF. Heroes are not affected. This does not give statless pieces a combat stat line.

Smyth's reward: take Extra Build Card free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Gain a second Build action card for the rest of the game (with Quartermaster's, three). Counts as a research type for technology without raising the target.

Smyth's reward: take Extra Move/Battle Card free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Gain a second Move/Battle action card for the rest of the game (with Marshal's, three). Counts as a research type for technology without raising the target.

Smyth's reward: take Extra Research Card free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Gain a second Research action card for the rest of the game (with Archivist's, three). Counts as a research type for technology without raising the target.

Smyth's reward: take Collector Optimizations free (cost and prerequisite waived) — Two of your collectors may share one location. An access partner's collector (Shared Resources or Open Borders) may share a location with yours only if that partner has this research too. Never more than two collectors on a location. The Economic spend still needs its full count of distinct tiles.

Smyth's reward: take Core Integration free (cost and prerequisite waived) — The Core bought together with a platform costs nothing (it still comes from the Core supply). A Core bought on its own still costs 1 water.

Smyth's reward: take Self Destruct free (cost and prerequisite waived) — In battle, any of your robot units (not heroes) with printed DMG 1 or more may self-destruct on its activation instead of attacking: its current DMG + 3 is dealt to every other unit and hero in the battle, every side, with the reactions of an area attack. The unit is lost.
